facility.name: Beginnings & Beyond Klein
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985): One staff file observed did not include a notarized affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The playground structure for the preschool age group contained broken boards on the slide, and nails protruding from the fence utilized as a border.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912): One staff file observed in care did not have a pre-employment affidavit available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle: Two transportation vehicles observed did not have child safety alarms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle (26 TAC §746.5625(a))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - Greater than Six Feet Exit of Slide: The slide on the preschool playground area use zone was not 6 feet from the border/perimeter.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - Greater than Six Feet Exit of Slide (26 TAC §746.4805(c))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: The outdoor area contained numerous hazards during the walkthrough. A water hose was unraveled near the pre-k play area, which poses a risk as a tripping hazard. A wired gate contained a hole in the gated area, and also a wire that was unraveled, which poses a risk to children in care.  The play structure that contained wood that had protruding nails from the wooden structure.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Two children files observed did not include an updated health statement. One child's file observed was enrolled in October of 2022, while the other child enrollment date was documented as January of 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2912): Two staff files hired after 09/01/2023 did not have a pre-employment affidavit available for review. Licensing staff provided a copy of form 2912 via email for staff to complete while Licensing was present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.1105(4))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Exceed One Hour Daily: From 7AM-8:19AM children between the ages of 2-8 were observed watching television for over an hour during meal/breakfast time.  After the school-age children left for the day, the television was still on, portraying Nickelodeon cartoons.  The childcare facility did not have a lesson plan, and/or activities for the age group that was observed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Exceed One Hour Daily (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(3))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The annual sanitation inspection report was dated 08/18/2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: A total of 14 children were observed in front of the television, 9 months-5 years of age. The two infants observed are 9 months and 11 months of age. The oldest child observed is 51 months older than the youngest infant in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes: Two infants were observed strapped into a 2-seater stroller upon arrival. The infants were in the stroller for approximately 30 minutes due to lack of staff.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes (26 TAC §746.2417(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Fourteen children, 9 months - 5 years of age were observed watching a television show, Bluey. The two infants observed were observed in a stroller.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Based on the information obtained from the DFPS investigation, an 18-month-old was watching television, and/or had access to screen time activities.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free of other activities: Based on the information obtained from the DFPS investigation, there is evidence to support a caregiver was conducting janitorial duties during the time of the incident.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free of other activities (26 TAC §746.1203(6))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: There are wooden boards observed on the outside/active play area that poses a hazard to children in care. Nails were observed on the outer layer of the wood.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement: Three out ten children records observed did not include a health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement (26 TAC §746.611(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Five out of ten children records did not contain the required information for their emergency contact. Three files observed included the name and contact number. The emergency contact did not include an address. One out of ten children records observed did not include an emergency contact.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission: Three out of ten children's records did not contain a start date.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission (26 TAC §746.605(3))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: Five out seven staff records observed did not have a current CPR/First-Aid certification. CPR certificates observed for five staff were online courses.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))
